YOUR PRIVACY

How we handle
your details.

What we collect

Your email address, which you need to give us to join. If you choose, your first name, your area or suburb, and your car’s make, model and year. We also record when you agreed to this notice and which version you agreed to. This site uses no cookies or trackers.

Why

Only to tell you when Serv60 opens and to offer you early access to the Serv60 app. Your optional details let us make that message relevant to you, for example whether the first hub is near you and can service your car.

Who can see it

The Serv60 team. Our hosting, database and email providers store and send it on our behalf and only on our instructions. We don’t sell your details or share them with anyone else. Our providers may store them outside South Africa, under agreements that require them to keep them secure.

How long we keep it

Until you unsubscribe, or until the waitlist closes after launch, whichever comes first. Then we delete it. To stop the form being abused, we also keep a scrambled form of your internet address for ten minutes.

Your choices

Joining is voluntary. Every email from us has a link to unsubscribe, which deletes your details straight away. To see or correct your details, reply to any email from us. If you are unhappy with how we handle your information, you can complain to the Information Regulator.
